integrity: Theorems follow from analytic kernel expansion and min–max/HS identities. Proof and executable finite corroboration are included, with no claim of outside certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharp asymptotic is proved for the second singular value and a summed rank-two HS tail only; no exact third singular or trace defect law. Finite numerical tests do not prove asymptotics. Some foundational full texts could not be inspected, so overlap risk remains.
title: Sharp second singular asymptotics and rank-two collapse for high Volterra powers
